mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_room_message (room_id, message_id, sender_id, sender_name, sender_type, message_role, content, at_member_id, quote_msg_id, is_preempted, ext_data) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{messageId}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{senderType}, #{messageRole}, #{content}, #{atMemberId}, #{quoteMsgId}, #{isPreempted}, #{extData})
mapper.select: SELECT sender_name, message_role, content, sender_type FROM ai_chat_room_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT room_id, message_id, content, create_time FROM ai_chat_room_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT room_id, message_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, sender_type, is_deleted FROM ai_chat_room_message WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_room_message SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
